---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an addition or change to the engine, CAOS support, build system, or NORNBRAIN integration layer
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the gap in the current engine, in the NORNBRAIN integration, or in the build and developer workflow.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see added or changed? Be as specific as you can about the interface, the data flow, and how it integrates with the existing engine structure.

## Scope

What is explicitly out of scope for this request? Bounded proposals are much easier to evaluate.

## Compatibility

Does this change affect compatibility with upstream openc2e, with original Creatures 3 save files, with existing CAOS scripts, or with the NORNBRAIN Python brain interface? Flag any breaking changes.

## Verification

How would you verify that the feature works correctly? Such as: specific test cases, manual reproduction steps, or observable engine behaviour.

## Relevant context

Links to related issues, upstream openc2e discussions, or sections of the NORNBRAIN project that this feature supports.
